Players Committee errata sheet slip of [[I'm Getting Pretty Good At This]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “If Finn and either Poe or Rey are in a battle together, you may add two battle destiny. OR Deploy Finn aboard any starship or vehicle from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/errata_2019.pdf#page=3 errata_2019.pdf], page 3 (PDF dated 21 March 2019, “Official text as of 7 February 2019”). Rendered from the PDF at 300 dpi and cropped to the slip with its title label; no other edits.
